findings.title: New16/mono exact-theme selectors change domain flow when only appearance changes
findings.introduced_by_increment: ANSI16 requires accentLightGreen; Mono requires accentGray AND firstsurfaceBlack. Other domain/size/motion guards remain.
findings.required_fix: Shared semantic agent-picker flow must be independent of exact accent/canvas/profile identity; remove these selectors during live component migration. Frozen spawn_flow receives intent/world/context and opens shared agent Picker without theme predicates.

findings.title: New reduced-mode postpainting expands the prohibited static-screen mechanism
findings.source: finish_reduced scans raw buffer based on literal selectedRGB, togglesREVERSED, rewritesforegrounds, recolors the whole underlay, collects arbitrary black-on-black glyphs for repaint, and addsDIM over the rectangle. Mono also changes theme.surfaces[3] only while this frame is selected.
findings.why_blocked: These are application-owned component/state/theme correction painters. They do not connect card rows/query/navigation/cursor to real Picker state. Exact80x24 opening cells cannot prove interaction or general data/layout parity. Existing fixed-row/cursor/input defects remain source-unchanged and unapproved.
findings.required_fix: Remove finish_reduced and conditional palette mutations with entire capsule_split_view painter and undrawn cursor path when the real shared Picker/row/layout/theme contracts replace it. Do not move these raw-frame corrections into a library crate.

findings.title: New16-color hint-ellipsis override also affects command palette and remains application-specific theme repair
findings.source: paint_capsule_palette_hints now chooses Role::Custom(Color::Gray) forAnsi16 overflow. Caller uses it for capsule_palette_open OR static agent-picker frame, so change is not limited to newly painted agent cards.
findings.required_fix: Resolve intended pinned HintBar overflow appearance through a shared semantic theme/profile/variant with a separate baseline decision. Verify command-palette and picker paths; do not infer all affected flows from agent-card opening captures.
